transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose I just seem to worry about everything lately. It's... clients, the market, my family, money. Even just little things, like whether moving to the condo was the right decision. It just... it feels a bit out of proportion to what is actually happening. So, I thought I should come in.
Have you experienced any episodes of intense fear or discomfort that reached a peak within minutes?
No... no, nothing like that. Just the worrying.
Have you been feeling unusually tired lately?
No, I don't think so. Just... the normal amount of tired, I suppose. Nothing unusual.
Have you been avoiding any activities or situations because of your worries?
No... I don't think so. I still go to work and do what I need to do. I haven't really stopped doing anything.
Have you been experiencing any physical symptoms like headaches or muscle tension?

Well, I suppose... yes, a bit. My neck and shoulders get pretty tight by the end of the day. It just feels like I've been bracing myself, I guess. And... sometimes I notice I'm clenching my jaw when I'm driving between listings, or just sitting at my desk. But that's about it.
Do you have any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind and are difficult to stop?

I suppose... yes, sometimes. It's just... well, even when I tell myself, 'Parin, this is not urgent,' it's hard to drop it. One concern just sort of... leads to another. And before I know it, I’ve spent half an hour just replaying small details I really meant to let go. But... I guess everyone does that sometimes.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?
No... not really. I wouldn't say I feel sad. I just... no, I haven't been feeling down.
Do you feel compelled to perform specific rituals or routines to reduce your anxiety?
No... I don't think so. I don't really do anything like that. I just try to keep busy with my listings, I suppose. But no specific routines.
Do you have thoughts that you consider unreasonable or senseless, but that keep coming back to you?
Unreasonable? No... I wouldn't say that. They're just... normal concerns, I think. Nothing senseless.
Do you find it difficult to control your worry once it starts?

I suppose... a little. Sometimes, even when I tell myself, 'Parin, this is not urgent,' it's hard to stop. One concern just sort of... leads to another. And before I know it, I’ve spent half an hour just replaying small details I meant to let go. So... yes, I guess it can be hard to turn off.
Do you think your worry is interfering with your daily life?

I suppose... it does, a bit. Mostly at work. Things like... just straightforward listing negotiations or looking over contracts. They're taking me a lot longer than they used to. I just... I keep feeling like I need to check everything again. I've even put off returning some calls because I just... I don't feel confident I've gone over it all carefully enough. So... yes, it gets in the way sometimes.
Do you often feel restless or on edge?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really noticed feeling like that. I mostly just sit at my desk and work, so... no, not restless.
Do you have thoughts that are intrusive or unwanted?
No... I don't believe so. I mean, I worry about work, like I said, but... they're just my own thoughts. Nothing... strange or out of nowhere, if that's what you mean. So, no.
Do you worry about everyday things, like chores or minor responsibilities, as much as you worry about bigger issues like work or finances?
I don't really think so. Chores are... they're just chores. I just get them done. It's really mostly just the work things I mentioned.
Do you worry about your health as much as you worry about work or finances?
No, not really. My health is fine, so... I don't spend much time thinking about it. Like I said, it's really just my job that takes up my attention.
Do you find yourself worrying about things even when everything seems to be going well?
No, I wouldn't say so. If things are fine, then... I'm fine. It's really just the work stuff, like I keep saying.
Do you worry about multiple areas of your life, such as work, family, and finances, or is your worry primarily focused on one area?

Well... I suppose it's not strictly just my job. I mean... it's clients and the real estate market, yes, but... I guess it bleeds into money, too. And my family. Even just second-guessing if moving to the condo was the right decision. 

I don't know, I just... I seem to worry about everything now. It feels a bit out of proportion to what's actually happening, I guess.
Do you think your worry is something that you could control if you tried harder?

I try. I mean... I'll tell myself, 'Parin, this is not urgent.' But... I don't know, it doesn't really work. One concern just leads to another. Before I know it, I've spent half an hour just... replaying small details I meant to let go of. So... no. I don't think trying harder fixes it.
Is there any area of your life where you feel you don't worry at all?
I don't know. I guess... not really. It just seems to be a bit of everything right now.
Do you worry about your relationships with friends as much as you worry about work or family?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't really thought about it. I guess... maybe not quite as much. Work and family are just... more on my mind, I suppose.
